visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the if Chain with a Function Table
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An if/else-if chain picks the arithmetic operation. Use an array of function pointers indexed in step with the symbols. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each operation is now its own small function, and the loop calls them through the table instead of branching. Adding an operation means adding one function and one table entry.
